purpose: Bounded extension routes plus explicit reviewed replacements for canonical onchain Market Data routes. Base v0.15 remains byte-stable; route overrides are fail-closed and may only target existing canonical asset ids.

route.provenance: Official Olas OLAS token and protocol-owned OLAS/WETH Uniswap V2 pair. Read-only cumulative-price historical TWAP from two block-pinned pair states using a 60-block recent-history window proven live on the standard public Ethereum RPC fabric; composed with same-cycle ETH/USD. No updatePrice transaction, keeper dependency, reserve spot price, paid RPC, signing, or execution authority.

OVER official Ethereum OVR token. Read-only Uniswap V3 OVR/WETH 1% pool discovered through the canonical Ethereum Uniswap V3 factory, priced by observe()-based 30-minute TWAP and composed with same-cycle ETH/USD. No slot0 spot-price authority, paid RPC, signing, or execution authority.

Beam official Ethereum BEAM token. Read-only canonical Uniswap V3 Factory-discovered BEAM/WETH 1% pool geometric 30-minute observe() TWAP, live-proven with positive active liquidity and sub-1% divergence, composed with same-cycle ETH/USD. No slot0 spot-price authority, paid RPC, signing, or execution authority.

Canonical multichain elizaOS token on BNB Chain priced from the PancakeSwap V3 elizaOS/USDC 0.25% pool. Preferred pricing is an observe()-based 5-minute geometric TWAP; if and only if the pool returns Uniswap V3 OLD because retained observation history is shorter, the resolver retries explicitly bounded shorter observe() windows 180s, 120s, then 60s and uses the longest successful window. Token and quote decimals are read onchain each cycle. USDC/USD is independently read from the BNB Chain Chainlink Data Feed and freshness/integrity checked; no hardcoded stablecoin peg, slot0 spot authority, paid RPC, signing, or execution authority.

Replaces stale Pyth stored-state dependency; no updater, spot-price authority, paid RPC, signing, or execution authority.

Uses block-pinned price_oracle() EMA composed with same-cycle ETH/USD.
